title: Founder & CEO
company_summary: A 22-person B2B services agency specialising in operations consulting for mid-market professional services firms.
raw_research: Dana Whitfield founded the firm in 2016 after eleven years in operations leadership roles at two larger consultancies. LinkedIn bio: 'I started this firm because I got tired of watching good operators drown in admin work that software should have handled years ago.' A recent podcast appearance has Dana discussing 'the intake bottleneck every services firm hits around 20-30 people' and describing personally approving every new client engagement and every hire. No co-founder or executive team is listed on the company site beyond Dana.
